# The timeline agreement corpus: every series on which ical-rs and
# recurring-ical-events 3.9.0 answer alike, over the calendars of
# tests/corpus/rie and the windows of windows.tsv. Three tab-separated fields:
# the calendar, the UID (`-` for every component with none), and the earliest
# 200 occurrences starting in the window, comma separated, each `start/end`.
# A start is UTC (Z), floating, or a date. Generated by harness/run.sh.
